subject: Phase-split implementation & fee reallocation — order form update
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@aeronix.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aeronix.com
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form (implementation phasing)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the call this morning. Procurement asked me to follow up in writing so we have a single source of truth for legal. Key asks from our side:

- Split the SOW into Phase 1 (POC + integration) and Phase 2 (full throughput capacity).
- Reallocate 40% of the total fee to Phase 1 and 60% to Phase 2; payment milestones to match.
- Add a clause that Phase 2 capacity deployment is contingent on a passing security checklist (SOC 2 evidence) we will send next week.

Can Redwood provide a redlined order form and a revised SOW that reflects the phased milestones and updated payment schedule? We need the documents for our internal legal review by EOD Friday.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Maria Santos
Director of IT Procurement
Aeronix

Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@aeronix.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form (implementation phasing)

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the clear summary — that works. We're preparing a redline and a split-SOW that maps the deliverables/milestones to your Phase 1/Phase 2 split and the 40/60 fee allocation.

Next steps from our side:
1) Legal will provide a redlined Order Form (with payment milestones and the conditional Phase 2 deployment clause).
2) Delivery team will produce an XLS with milestone dates and acceptance criteria (I'll include Karthik so we can align on go-to-market timing).
3) We'll aim to get the documents to you by EOD Thursday so your legal can review before Friday's deadline.

Laura — can you prioritize a targeted redline that doesn't change standard indemnities but captures: conditional Phase 2 launch, milestone invoices, and a 30-day invoice net for Phase 1?

Maria — is there a specific DocuSign process your legal team requires (single signing party vs vendor sign first)?

-Jordan

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form (implementation phasing)

Jordan / Karthik —

Attached is a focused redline of the Order Form (Aeronix_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf). Key changes I made:

- Section 2 (Fees & Payment): inserted milestone schedule that allocates 40% at Phase 1 completion and 60% at Phase 2 completion; clarified invoice timing (30 days net for Phase 1, 45 days net for Phase 2) per Jordan's ask.
- New clause 7.3 (Conditional Phase 2 Launch): "Phase 2 deployment is conditioned on customer satisfaction of the security checklist provided by Redwood and receipt of SOC 2 Type II evidence or equivalent."
- Kept standard liability and indemnity language intact; moved a non-substantive definitional clause into an exhibit to avoid repeated redlines.

I also created SOW_phase-split_breakdown.xlsx with milestones and acceptance criteria (see delivery column). Delivery team: please verify dates and ramp assumptions; I used a 6-week gap between Phase 1 acceptance and Phase 2 start as a placeholder.

A few legal notes for sales to consider before pushing to DocuSign:
- The conditional language is intentionally narrow — it ties Phase 2 to receipt of evidence, not to an open-ended approval process. If Aeronix wants a hard SLA on timing for producing evidence, that will be a commercial ask.
- If procurement requests a retention or extended audit clause, escalate to me immediately; that will need commercial review.

I'll be on standby to finalize language after Aeronix provides any comments.

-Laura

Attachments: Aeronix_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf; SOW_phase-split_breakdown.xlsx
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@aeronix.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aeronix.com
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form (implementation phasing)

Jordan / Laura —

Appreciate the redlines and the milestone sheet. Our internal counsel reviewed the Order Form and provided two minor asks:

1) Change "45 days net for Phase 2" to "60 days net for Phase 2" (procurement cashflow policy).
2) Add a one-sentence clause confirming Redwood will provide SOC 2 artifacts within 10 business days of request (this is procedural; not a gating right).

If you can accept those, we can approve the redline and we prefer Redwood to send the DocuSign envelope (Aeronix signs last).

Can we get the updated PDF + DocuSign link today?

Thanks,
Maria

Attachments: Aeronix_internal_comments.pdf

Maria —

Thanks — we can accept both requests. Laura, I made the two edits per Aeronix and attached the final PDF. Also attaching the DocuSign envelope link (DocuSign-envelope-link.txt) — vendor signs first, Aeronix signs last as requested.

Best,
